identityAndPermissions.exactOwnerPin: The removed wrapper's mutable entry.team/team.owner identity protection is explicitly retained by assertCaptured before and after the unchanged composite authority/allocation checks.
identityAndPermissions.canonical: TeamOwner.capturedProviderAuthority obtains authorizeTeamGrant(state, store, original principal, read) and providerAuthorized before returning either current or roster-not-applicable.
identityAndPermissions.providerFallback: With beforeTeamAuthority present, or without the canonical callback, authorizeRuntimeAccess(original principal, binding, provider, optional prelude) enters TeamDeliveryAuthority.runtimeAccess. Its provider branch requires memberAuthorized(admit) and recursively runtimeAccess(original principal, binding, control). The control branch authorizes that same principal for read; absent/revoked/read-less grants return false after the exception is caught.
identityAndPermissions.implementation: TeamOwner passes authorize to this.authorize; this.authorize calls authorizeTeamGrant(this.state(), this.store, principal, permission). authorizeTeamGrant rejects missing, revoked, or missing-permission grants.
identityAndPermissions.productionCaller: RuntimeTeamCoordinator is the sole production factory invocation found; it supplies assertWriter, canonical assertProviderAuthority and beforeTeamAuthority.
identityAndPermissions.conclusion: No extra permission fence is needed: all assertCurrent branches retain own-principal read authorization. Existing binding/config/profile/principal pinning, writer check, prelude and allocation guard are preserved.
